power_design_criterion.status: RECORDED — C1 DESIGN CRITERION; NOT AN OBSERVED RETENTION AND NOT A SECOND ACCEPTANCE GATE
power_design_criterion.model: Independent Bernoulli retention on each row, with the six seeds independent, as in the power review's required-retention table.
power_design_criterion.meaning: At the upper-bound 63-row scenario, reaching 80% all-six-seed power requires a common retention of at least 0.984017. The corresponding values are 0.984271 at 64 rows and 0.983204 at the 60-row floor. This sizes the planned design; it is not an observed retention and is not a second post-run acceptance gate. The observed-run acceptance rule remains the 0.95 preservation threshold.

c1_acceptance_rule.unit: observed minimum paired-control available rows across all six seeds and both A- and K- paths
c1_acceptance_rule.acceptance_condition: Every required seed and both paths have at least 60 available rows and retained / denominator >= 0.95.
